emma: quick heads-up: planned staging cutover 02:30 UTC touching API header-split, router parse-buffer tweak, console routing. propose pin runtime for window + hold until prewarm + short canary.
raj: +1. last dry-run on shard-4 showed parse_overflow and a small spike in kv_eviction.
kevin: logs from dry-run:
[staging-router] WARN parse_overflow id=shard-4
[staging-runtime] INFO kv_eviction count=22 reason=header_pressure
olivia: rollback criteria: sustained 5xx >0.5% for 10m OR kv_eviction_rate >0.015 for 5m OR session.reset_rate doubles. abort if p95 >550ms.
raj: i'll add transient grafana panels for router.parse_overflow, kv_eviction_rate, api.header_size_p95 and a firing alert for eviction_rate >0.01 for 5m.
emma: propose pin runtime v2.16.1 for staging window and disable console split FF until warmup completes. warmup 20m prior, ramp 30/60/100.
kevin: deploy commands i'll run once we agree:
/deploy hold staging --reason "header-split-safety" --by kevin --until 2819003600
/deploy prewarm staging --shard shard-4 --type cache --by kevin
deploy-bot: scheduled release at 2025-01-10T02:30Z for staging. to place a hold run `/deploy hold staging`.
emma: agreed. kevin please pin and place the hold. keep updates short here for oncall.
kevin: running `/deploy hold staging --reason "header-split-safety"` now.
deploy-bot: hold placed by kevin at 2819000055 (reason: header-split-safety)
raj: prewarm started; ETA ~11m. i'll watch the panels and call lift when we hit 15m stable with 5xx <0.2% and eviction_rate <0.008.
emma: thanks all. concise updates only in this thread.
